resource.title: Physics III: Vibrations and Waves (MIT 8.03SC, MIT OpenCourseWare)
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放：24 讲视频、讲义、习题与解答，无需注册
resource.covers: 讲义目录逐讲覆盖：简谐振动、阻尼自由振动、受迫振动与共振（Lecture 1–3）、耦合振动与简正模式（Lecture 4、7）、波动方程与驻波/傅里叶级数（Lecture 9）、行波与声波（10–11）、电磁波（12–13）、Snell 定律（16）、偏振（17、18）、干涉（20）、衍射与分辨（22）。没有覆盖：几何光学成像（透镜/成像系统）与傅里叶光学（4f 系统、空间滤波）——需要另找光学课补

courses.prereq_text: Prereq: Calculus II (GIR) and Physics II (GIR)
courses.scope_text: Mechanical vibrations and waves; simple harmonic motion, superposition, forced vibrations and resonance, coupled oscillations, and normal modes; vibrations of continuous systems; reflection and refraction; phase and group velocity. Optics; wave solutions to Maxwell's equations; polarization; Snell's Law, interference, Huygens's principle, Fraunhofer diffraction, and gratings.

courses.course: PHYS 2C Physics—Fluids, Waves, Thermodynamics, and Optics
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: PHYS 2A or 4A, and MATH 20C or 31BH. Recommended preparation: prior or concurrent enrollment in MATH 20D. Prior completion of PHYS 2B is strongly recommended.
courses.scope_text: Continuation of PHYS 2B covering fluid mechanics, waves in elastic media, sound waves, temperature, heat and the first law of thermodynamics, kinetic theory of gases, entropy and the second law of thermodynamics, Maxwell's equations, electromagnetic waves, geometric optics, interference and diffraction.
courses.hours_text: PHYS 2C. Physics—Fluids, Waves, Thermodynamics, and Optics (4)

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: PHYS 4A-B-C-D, MATH 20A-B-C or 31BH, 20D, 20E or 31CH, and 18 or 20F or 31AH.
courses.scope_text: Phase flows, bifurcations, linear oscillations, calculus of variations, Lagrangian dynamics, conservation laws, central forces, systems of particles, collisions, coupled oscillations.

notes: 候选判断：N.1.1 由 UCSD PHYS 2C 'PHYS 2A or 4A' 与 PHYS 110A 'PHYS 4A-B-C-D' 明确要求（MIT 8.03 里没有列 Physics I，只列 Physics II，所以对 N.1.1 只靠 UCSD 两门支撑）；M.2.1 由 UCSD PHYS 110A 先修原文里的 '20D'（MATH 20D = Introduction to Differential Equations）明确要求，MIT 8.03 目录不要求 ODE（但 OCW 8.03SC 大纲写 18.02，也不含 18.03）；N.1.2 三门都要求（'Physics II (GIR)'、'prior…PHYS 2B strongly recommended'、'PHYS 4B-C'）；M.1.9（傅里叶分析）没有任何一门写成先修，MIT 8.03 只把傅里叶级数/变换当作课内内容（Lecture 9、14），故 not_mentioned。share：MIT 8.03 整门课就是振动+波+光学，但缺几何光学成像与傅里叶光学，故在 covers 里写明边界；UCSD 2C 只有波与光学一半属于本技能，110A 只有振荡/耦合振动部分属于本技能。
